import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import numpy as np
root=Path("/opt/data/private/ZHY/data/supermimic_for_q1/BONES_RF13_LOWER_RESIDUAL_SOMA300_E4096_MAX01H_20261028")
rows=json.loads((root/"evaluation/evaluation_library.json").read_text())["splits"]["train"]
fixed=["walk_ff_stop_180_R_002__A095","walk_ff_start_180_R_002__A071","triumph_two_handed_001__A058"]
out=[]
for repeat in range(3):
 with np.load(root/"evaluation"/("stage_03_repeat"+str(repeat)+".npz"), allow_pickle=False) as trace:
  for name in fixed:
   index=next(i for i,row in enumerate(rows) if row["name"]==name)
   count=int(trace["steps"][index])
   actual=trace["states"][:count,index,:2]
   reference=trace["reference_p"][:count,index,:2]
   ref_delta=reference[-1]-reference[0]
   actual_delta=actual[-1]-actual[0]
   ref_net=float(np.linalg.norm(ref_delta))
   loaded=trace["force"][:count,index]>5.
   support=loaded[:,0].astype(int)+2*loaded[:,1].astype(int)
   single=support[(support==1)|(support==2)]
   slips=trace["slip"][:count,index][loaded]
   out.append({"label":"stage_03","repeat":repeat,"name":name,"steps":count,
    "failed":bool(trace["failed"][index]),"poststep_span_seconds":(count-1)*.02,
    "actual_xy_net_m":actual_delta.tolist(),"reference_xy_net_m":ref_delta.tolist(),
    "actual_along_reference_net_m":float(actual_delta@ref_delta/ref_net) if ref_net else None,
    "reference_net_m":ref_net,
    "actual_xy_path_m":float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(actual,axis=0),axis=1).sum()),
    "reference_xy_path_m":float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(reference,axis=0),axis=1).sum()),
    "loaded_slip_mps":float(slips.mean()) if slips.size else None,
    "single_support_fraction":float(((support==1)|(support==2)).mean()),
    "double_support_fraction":float((support==3).mean()),
    "raw_single_support_side_changes":int(np.count_nonzero(np.diff(single)))})
print(json.dumps({"captured_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"new_physics_steps":0,"new_optimizer_steps":0,
"definition":"Own surviving post-step root XY displacement from first to last saved post-step state; reference uses identical frames. No root-alignment removal. Raw support changes are not step counts. Native solved last5ms force>5N, not integrated20ms impulse.",
"rows":out},allow_nan=False))
